votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 9 of 2022 Redistricting City Council District Boundaries, based on the 2020 Census results as shown on the attached map marked Exhibit A.
votes.description: Adopts a resolution changing Salt Lake City Council district boundaries based on 2020 Census results to create substantially equal populations between districts for fairer representation.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 13 of 2022 Appointment to the Utah Inland Port Authority Board, Council Member Victoria Petro-Eschler.
votes.description: Approves a resolution confirming the appointment of Council Member Victoria Petro-Eschler to the Utah Inland Port Authority Board.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 24 of 2022 20 MPH Default Speed Limit on City Streets.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance amending Section 12.36.020 of the Salt Lake City Code to change the default prima facie speed limit on city streets from 25 mph to 20 mph.
